_doc: How many runs (saves) of one world a player may keep, by billing tier (free · story = Traveler · vivid = Voyager). null = no count limit. 10-15 play rules §4; adventure = 1 main + 3 (10-21, to be confirmed). core/save_limits.py; the platform's entitlements.limits.saves_sandbox / saves_adventure win when present.
